description: Round-trip a record made of one field of every scalar wire type (boolean, the four signed and unsigned fixed-width integers, both 64-bit integers, both floating-point widths, a length-prefixed UTF-8 string, a 16-byte globally-unique identifier rendered in canonical hyphenated form, and a date stored as an absolute instant). The adapter encodes the record to the wire byte sequence, then decodes that byte sequence back into a record. The output reports the encoded bytes as a lowercase hex string and the decoded field values, demonstrating that every scalar type survives an encode/decode cycle unchanged.
